mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 57 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail under a Waning Crescent moon.

The City of Verona remains busy with maintenance and planning. You can stay updated on infrastructure projects and public services by subscribing to the city newsletter or checking the latest development updates regarding the Plan Commission agenda for November 4th.

Today is a great day to get out, with the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga classes at Insight Wellness, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for ART House 360 events starting tomorrow.
In a recent report, on October 3, an officer arrested a 19-year-old Verona man who was found in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop for expired registration.
You are in for a treat with today's flavor of the day, Turtle Cheesecake. The store is currently closed, but they open today at 10:00 AM so you can swing by and grab a scoop.
